ValidationRule.description: This validation will stop user form editing the records when the record Status is Approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c ,"Data Processor") || ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c ,"Data Validator") || ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c ,"Data Approver"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Approved") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit the records once it is Approved by Data Approver.
